$comment: Generated from quality.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to quality.yaml>`. Do not edit.

criterion.description: The quality criterion assessed, e.g. licence_present.

message.description: The finding, as a sentence a reviewer can act on.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (ADR-0015). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

description: The payload of a quality or validation agent: a score over an existing record and the findings behind it. Grounded on the input itself (grounding mode input_only or none).

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.
